Short Description:
This project focuses on developing an advanced Market Basket Analysis and Recommendation Engine leveraging Pandas for data manipulation, the Apriori algorithm for association rule mining, and Cosine Similarity for item-based collaborative filtering. The system is designed to analyze transactional data to uncover frequent itemsets and generate meaningful product recommendations, enhancing cross-selling strategies in retail environments.(DataCamp)

Python Code:

# market_basket_analysis_recommendation_engine.py

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from mlxtend.frequent_patterns import apriori, association_rules
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv('retail_transactions.csv')

# Data Preprocessing
data.dropna(subset=['InvoiceNo', 'Description'], inplace=True)
data['Description'] = data['Description'].str.strip()
data['InvoiceNo'] = data['InvoiceNo'].astype(str)

# Create a basket matrix
basket: pd.DataFrame = (data
                        .groupby(['InvoiceNo', 'Description'])['Quantity']
                        .sum().unstack().reset_index().fillna(0)
                        .set_index('InvoiceNo'))

# Encode quantities to 1 and 0
def encode_units(x: float) -> int:
    return 1 if x >= 1 else 0

basket_sets: pd.DataFrame = basket.applymap(encode_units)

# Apply Apriori Algorithm
frequent_itemsets: pd.DataFrame = apriori(basket_sets, min_support=0.05, use_colnames=True)

# Generate Association Rules
rules: pd.DataFrame = association_rules(frequent_itemsets, metric="lift", min_threshold=1)

# Function to get recommendations
def get_recommendations(item: str, rules_df: pd.DataFrame, top_n: int = 5) -> pd.DataFrame:
    filtered_rules: pd.DataFrame = rules_df[rules_df['antecedents'].apply(lambda x: item in x)]
    sorted_rules: pd.DataFrame = filtered_rules.sort_values(by='lift', ascending=False)
    recommendations: pd.DataFrame = sorted_rules.head(top_n)
    return recommendations[['antecedents', 'consequents', 'support', 'confidence', 'lift']]

# Example usage
item_to_recommend: str = 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER'
recommendations_df: pd.DataFrame = get_recommendations(item_to_recommend, rules)
print(f"Recommendations for {item_to_recommend}:\n", recommendations_df)

# Cosine Similarity for Item-Based Collaborative Filtering
# Transpose the basket matrix for item-item similarity
item_basket: pd.DataFrame = basket_sets.T

# Compute cosine similarity
item_similarity: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame(cosine_similarity(item_basket),
                                             index=item_basket.index,
                                             columns=item_basket.index)

# Function to get similar items
def get_similar_items(item_name: str, similarity_df: pd.DataFrame, top_n: int = 5) -> pd.Series:
    similar_scores: pd.Series = similarity_df[item_name].sort_values(ascending=False)
    similar_items: pd.Series = similar_scores.iloc[1:top_n+1]
    return similar_items

# Example usage
similar_items_series: pd.Series = get_similar_items(item_to_recommend, item_similarity)
print(f"Items similar to {item_to_recommend}:\n", similar_items_series)

# Visualization of top 10 frequent items
item_counts: pd.Series = data['Description'].value_counts().head(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=item_counts.values, y=item_counts.index)
plt.title('Top 10 Frequent Items')
plt.xlabel('Frequency')
plt.ylabel('Items')
plt.show()
